read_pass_1.finding: 2010 iCLIP supplement now readable. It prints a different oligo generation from the one implied by Linder 2015 read processing: L3 linker with 3-prime puromycin, RT primers with NNN plus a 2-nt experiment barcode, a cut oligo ending AAAA, and Illumina paired-end PCR primers.

read_pass_2.locations: /husky/henriksson/NGS101_papers/sources/miclip__10.1038+nmeth.3453/41594_2010_BFnsmb1838_MOESM21_ESM.pdf.txt: title/authors lines 1-8; Supplementary Methods heading line 2047 through the iCLIP protocol, high-throughput sequencing and mapping paragraphs (lines 2047-2200, printed pp.1-5; publisher footer "Nature Structural & Molecular Biology: doi:10.1038/nsmb.1838"); compared with Linder 2015 /husky/henriksson/NGS101_papers/sources/miclip__10.1038+nmeth.3453/nmeth.3453_PMC4487409.xml.txt lines 155-177 (library preparation and read pre-processing).
read_pass_2.finding: Agree with read_pass_1. The 2010 supplement prints L3 5-prime-phosphate-UGAGAUCGGAAGAGCGGTTCAG-3-prime-puromycin; three RT primers 5-prime-phosphate-NNN[CA|GA|TG]AGATCGGAAGAGCGTCGTGGATCCTGAACCGC(TC) with a 3-nt random and 2-nt experiment barcode; the BamHI cut primer GTTCAGGATCCACGACGCTCTTCAAAA; and two Illumina paired-end PCR primers; 54-nt GA2 reads. Linder 2015 says circularization and re-linearization follow the iCLIP protocol but its read pre-processing moves a "second part of the iCLIP random barcode" after an experimental barcode, which the 2010 NNN+2-nt design does not have. The 2010 supplement therefore does not identify the 2015 oligo variant.

missing_claims.claim: The exact adapter/RT-primer variant used in each 2015 miCLIP library is not established by the currently readable originals
missing_claims.evidence: Grozhik 2017 and Huppertz 2014 print candidate L3 and RT/PCR families, resolving categorical sequence absence. Linder 2015 Methods delegate to König 2010; its original Supplementary Methods attachment remains inaccessible, and no checked source maps every 2015 sample to a primer variant.
missing_claims.evidence_update: 2026-10-17: the König 2010 Supplementary Methods (MOESM21) is now retrieved and read by two readers; it prints the 2010 oligo generation, which does not match the barcode layout used in Linder 2015 read processing. The claim stays blocked: no checked source maps the 2015 libraries to a primer variant, and GEO/SRA run records are not inspected.

conclusion: Two independent readers checked the original 2010 iCLIP article and the accessible 2014/2017 detailed family protocols. Their L3 adapter and RT/PCR families are published; the 2010 Supplementary Methods remains inaccessible, and no source yet assigns a precise oligo variant to the 2015 miCLIP experiment. No missing-information claim is accepted.
